summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to the stated Vue component
details: The package advertises a Vue Content Builder renderer component, but its package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (pinned v1.3.13), stages it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line bundle using rotated string-array indirection (a `WV8StW` shift routine) and hex/numeric identifier mangling, so its behavior is opaque to review. `setup.mjs` itself is written with obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and per-function string-lookup objects wrapping the platform detection, download, unzip, and execFileSync logic. The Bun-runtime-fetch + obfuscated-sibling-exec pattern has no relation to a Vue component, and obfuscation of the install-time glue that chooses what to run is inconsistent with legitimate build tooling. The net effect on `npm install` is that a fresh alternate language runtime is fetched from the network and used to execute an opaque bundled payload on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
